name: KIC 3438609
description: A red-clump giant burning helium in its core in the Kepler field, 9.8 solar radii and 2.39 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 3438609 (Gold): Radius (Mosser scale, solar radii) 9.8454 +/- 0.1734

mass.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 3438609 (Gold): Mass (Mosser scale, solar masses) 2.3887 +/- 0.0921

temperature.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 3438609 (Gold): APOGEE effective temperature (K) 5049.9077 +/- 48.9562

gravity.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 3438609 (Gold): Asteroseismic log g 2.8325 +/- 0.0038

color.reason: The star lies in the Galactic plane hundreds to thousands of parsecs away, where interstellar dust reddens its spectra, and the color routes do not remove it; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red-clump giant in the Kepler field, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations give 2.39 solar masses and 9.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,050 K at its surface.
